_doc: Real articles collected on 19 Nov 2026 (snapshot time 06:45 UTC / 12:15 IST). Titles and URLs are the publishers' own. 'extract' stands in for the RSS description: it is a short paraphrase of the facts reported, written for this fixture, not publisher text. time_precision 'day' means only the date was shown, so no clock time is displayed for that article.

articles.title: Trump arrives in China for historic meeting with Xi, Putin
articles.extract: President Donald Trump arrived in Shenzhen for the APEC summit ahead of historic trilateral talks on Thursday with Chinese leader Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin. The meeting is expected to focus on the Iran war, Russia's war in Ukraine and strategic stability, though expectations for a concrete outcome are low. Xi opened the summit calling for free trade and AI cooperation.

articles.title: Live updates: Trump sits down with Putin and Xi separately before historic three-way talks
articles.extract: At the APEC summit in Shenzhen, President Donald Trump is holding one-on-one meetings with Putin and Xi, followed by an unprecedented meeting with both leaders at the same time. Chinese state media said Trump and Xi were meeting on the sidelines of the summit.

articles.title: Trump meeting Xi, Putin in China for high-stakes talks: APEC summit latest
articles.extract: Trump held one-on-one talks with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen, where leaders gathered for the annual APEC summit. Xinhua reported that the Trump-Xi bilateral meeting began at Kylin Villa on the sidelines of the summit on Thursday.

articles.title: APEC live: Trump arrives at resort for meetings with Xi, Putin
articles.extract: Trump met Putin on the sidelines of the APEC forum in Shenzhen after the plenary leaders session, ahead of a bilateral with Xi and a trilateral among the three. Xi and Trump are holding their third summit of the year as they manage a fraught superpower rivalry.

articles.title: What do Trump, Putin and Xi want from their Shenzhen meeting?
articles.extract: Explainer: the US, Chinese and Russian leaders are to hold their first three-way talks on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen. The White House has said Trump plans to discuss the war with Iran and a possible three-way agreement on nuclear arms with Xi and Putin.

articles.title: Trump to meet with China's Xi and Russia's Putin at historic trilateral sit-down on nuclear non-proliferation
articles.extract: China's foreign ministry confirmed the trilateral meeting of Trump, Xi and Putin in Shenzhen on Thursday. A senior US official said Washington does not expect to reach any kind of agreement and described the talks as an entry point on nuclear matters.

articles.title: "Ukrainians are not in room": Dhruva Jaishankar casts doubt on outcomes of Trump-Xi-Putin trilateral talks in Shenzhen
articles.extract: Dhruva Jaishankar of ORF America said the Trump, Xi and Putin trilateral in Shenzhen is largely aimed at ending the war in Ukraine, but the absence of Ukraine and other stakeholders raises scepticism about what the talks can achieve.

articles.title: What Trump, Putin, and Xi want from their meeting in Shenzhen
articles.extract: Opinion and analysis from Atlantic Council experts arguing that Putin proposed the trilateral to create a Yalta-like setting where great powers decide Ukraine's fate, and that Trump framed it around nuclear arms control.

articles.title: Iran live updates: Trump says Iran 'looking at gases' and 'biological weapons' amid dirty bomb report
articles.extract: A tanker was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz, the UK maritime agency UKMTO said. Iran threatened regional countries that allow the US to operate, the US Treasury targeted more Iranian proxy networks, and Trump claimed Iran was looking at gases and biological weapons amid a dirty bomb report.

articles.title: Three Indian sailors safe after attack on oil tanker in Gulf on Nov 18: Minister
articles.extract: An Indian minister said three Indian sailors are safe after a projectile attack on another oil tanker in the Gulf on November 18. A US military official said American warplanes struck an Iranian missile site. The UAE condemned Iranian attacks on Kuwait and Bahrain.

articles.title: Live Updates: War returns to Iran with Israel, US strikes
articles.extract: The US tightened its Iran blockade with curbs on oil transfers at sea, an advisory showed. The US intelligence director said threats from Iran had increased substantially, and the US Homeland Security chief dismissed an Iran dirty bomb report.

articles.title: US/Israel-Iran war: What UAE residents need to know today (Nov. 18, 2026)
articles.extract: An ADNOC ship was attacked and flights to Saudi Arabia were suspended as Iran-linked Gulf tensions hit the UAE. Diplomatic efforts to end the war that began on February 28 remain stalled. US Treasury Secretary Bessent predicted Iran's economy could contract 25% over the coming year.

articles.title: Nov. 18: US reissues security warnings to Americans in Gulf after Iranian strikes
articles.extract: The US reissued security warnings to Americans in the Gulf after Iranian strikes. Bahrain said its air defences intercepted Iranian attacks. Israel is considering military action against Iran in the coming days, Channel 12 reported without citing a source.

articles.title: Trump said to privately vent at Vance for blaming GOP's shellacking in midterms on Iran war
articles.extract: Citing unnamed sources, a report says Trump privately vented at Vance over remarks blaming the midterm losses on the war.

articles.title: Iran War Executive Update — November 18, 2026
articles.extract: Newsletter summary claiming a third drone strike on a US radar in Bahrain and a US strike on Qeshm Island.

articles.title: NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for Third Quarter Fiscal 2027
articles.extract: NVIDIA reported third-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $115.8 billion, up 20% from the previous quarter and up 103% from a year ago. Data Center revenue was $107.6 billion, up 110%. Revenue for the fourth quarter is expected to be $130.0 billion, plus or minus 2%. Interim CEO Colette Kress said Vera Rubin is off to an explosive start.

articles.title: NVIDIA CORP - Form 8-K - Third Quarter Fiscal 2027 results
articles.extract: Form 8-K exhibit: NVIDIA revenue of $115.8 billion for the quarter ended October 25, 2026, up 103% from a year ago; Data Center revenue of $107.6 billion; GAAP gross margin 74.8%; Vera Rubin NVL72 has shipped.

articles.title: Nvidia says it doesn't plan to reappoint Jensen Huang as CEO
articles.extract: During the Nvidia earnings call, chairman Harvey C. Jones said Jensen Huang's return was not being considered and that the board, which accepted his resignation unanimously, does not intend to reinstate him as CEO, despite Huang's offer to come back.

articles.title: Nvidia earnings live: Nvidia posts Q3 beat as revenue rose 103% YOY to $115.8B, board says it will not reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO
articles.extract: Nvidia earned $2.68 per share on revenue of $115.8 billion. Interim CEO Colette Kress said the cloud revenue backlog is now $2.5 trillion and that CPU revenue will double in fiscal 2028. The board says it will not reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO.

articles.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang Open to Rejoining as CEO Pending Board Decision
articles.extract: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said in a statement he was willing to return to the helm after his ouster last week, citing calls from employees, investors and customers, though the board is not considering the idea.

articles.title: NVIDIA Announces CEO Transition
articles.extract: The NVIDIA board announced that Jensen Huang has resigned as president, chief executive officer and board member, effective immediately. CFO Colette Kress was appointed interim CEO and Harvey C. Jones became the first chair of the board.

articles.title: Jensen Huang agrees to testify before US House, says can resume CEO role
articles.extract: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang agreed to transcribed interviews with several US House committees on December 1. He stepped down after reports of extramarital affairs, including one allegedly involving a suspected Chinese spy, which raised questions over exports of Nvidia AI chips to China.

articles.title: Fed minutes October 2026: Officials expect more rate hikes, worry about AI
articles.extract: Minutes from the Federal Reserve's October meeting, where it held its benchmark rate in a 3.75% to 4% range, show almost all participants said further rate hikes would likely be appropriate. AI was discussed as a driver of both inflation and potential financial instability. Officials expect inflation to fall sharply in 2027 and beyond.

articles.title: Fed Minutes Show Almost All Officials Expect More Rate Hikes
articles.extract: Minutes of the FOMC October 27-28 meeting show nearly all Federal Reserve officials agreed they would likely have to raise interest rates in the months ahead to return inflation to the 2% target in a timely manner.

articles.title: Oil Prices Drop as Crude Benchmarks Slide on November 18, 2026
articles.extract: Brent crude futures fell $0.53 to $92.61 a barrel and WTI fell $0.95 to $85.06 in Asian trade on November 18 as crude benchmarks slid.

articles.title: Oil price today: Brent slips as fresh data shows rise in US crude inventory
articles.extract: Brent crude fell to $92.14 after industry data showed US crude stocks rose by 5.28 million barrels, though ongoing US-Iran fighting and disruption in the Strait of Hormuz limited the drop in oil prices.

articles.title: Brent oil - Price - Chart - Historical Data - News
articles.extract: Brent crude oil fell to 91.68 USD a barrel on November 18, 2026. Over the past month the Brent oil price has fallen 16.31%, but it is still 44.35% higher than a year ago.

articles.title: Stock Market Close: Sensex sheds 500 pts, Nifty at 25,228; consumer durables top sectoral loser
articles.extract: The Sensex fell about 500 points, or 0.61%, to close near 82,030 on Wednesday, while the Nifty 50 ended near 25,228. Consumer durables were the top sectoral loser on the stock market.

articles.title: Sensex Falls 500 Pts; Nifty Slips Below 25,250 on Profit Booking
articles.extract: Market close report: Sensex and Nifty decline on profit booking. Open Free Demat Account.

articles.title: Closing Bell, 18 November 2026: Sensex and Nifty Fall as Profit Booking, Metal Stocks Weigh
articles.extract: Brokerage market wrap: Sensex and Nifty fell on profit booking and weakness in metal stocks.

articles.title: Stock Market Highlights: Sensex ends 446 pts up; Nifty at 26,192; Financial, O&G shares gain
articles.extract: Indian equity markets ended higher with Sensex and Nifty inching closer to record levels, supported by financials and oil and gas stocks.

articles.title: COP31 deadlock persists as countries launch new 'climate reality check'
articles.extract: At COP31 in Antalya, countries launched a new global check on whether climate promises are being kept, while ministers stayed deadlocked on who pays, how fast the world moves away from fossil fuels and whether the transition can be just for poorer countries. COP31 is set to close on Friday, and observers expect at least one extra night.

articles.title: Tensions rise over draft climate deal at COP31
articles.extract: A contentious 18-page draft cover decision has laid bare divisions between delegates at the COP31 climate talks in Turkiye, which end on Friday. The summit is hosted jointly by Turkey and Australia and runs from November 9 to 20.

articles.title: Cropped 18 November 2026: COP31 special edition
articles.extract: At COP31, countries failed to reach consensus in agriculture negotiations, pushing the climate talks track back to intersessional discussions in Bonn, while new initiatives on food, oceans, peatlands and methane were launched.

articles.title: Delhi air pollution: AQI drops to 214; Grap-III curbs go, schools reopen
articles.extract: Delhi's air quality index eased to 214 at 7 am on Wednesday, in the poor category, according to the Central Pollution Control Board. GRAP Stage III restrictions were lifted and schools resumed physical classes, while Stages I and II of the pollution curbs remain in force.

articles.title: Delhi's air quality 'poor' with 232 AQI, capital records season's coldest morning at 11°C
articles.extract: Delhi's air quality index settled at 232 in the poor category on Wednesday as the capital recorded its coldest morning of the season at 11 degrees. Vehicular emissions were the biggest contributor to PM2.5 pollution, and air quality is likely to turn very poor on Friday amid unfavourable weather.

articles.title: Delhi's air quality drops to poor category with AQI at 289
articles.extract: Delhi air quality index rose to 289 on Thursday morning.

articles.title: World News in Brief: Ebola cases double in DR Congo, chemical exposure starts before birth, Türk concern over EU-Rwanda transfer plan
articles.extract: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has more than doubled in three months, with more than 11,000 cases and 5,400 deaths reported in 67 health zones across eight provinces, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said on Tuesday, opening the third meeting of the emergency committee on the Bundibugyo virus disease epidemic.

articles.title: Union Health Ministry proposes amending the New Drugs and Clinical Trials Rules, 2019, to bring antimicrobials under central regulatory oversight
articles.extract: The Union Health Ministry has proposed amending the New Drugs and Clinical Trials Rules, 2019, to bring antimicrobials under central regulatory oversight.

articles.title: Union Health Ministry proposes a separate licensing framework for wholesale sale of bulk drugs
articles.extract: The Union Health Ministry has proposed a separate licensing framework for the wholesale sale of bulk drugs, in a second draft on drug regulation.

articles.title: Supreme Court Rejects Trump Appeal Defending Diversity-Related Grant Cuts
articles.extract: The US Supreme Court declined to hear an appeal by President Donald Trump's administration of a decision against its cuts to about $59 million in federal grants to University of California researchers, part of his crackdown on diversity, equity and inclusion. The lower court ruling stands and none of the nine justices noted a dissent.

articles.title: Supreme Court declines Donald Trump administration's DEI research grant appeal
articles.extract: The Supreme Court declined to hear an appeal from the Trump administration in its bid to terminate research grants to University of California researchers as part of its push against diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives, leaving a May ruling of the 9th Circuit appeals court in place. There were no noted dissents.

articles.title: Daily Indian Funding Roundup & Key News - 17 November 2026: Dreamteam Raises $53 Million, Urban Company Opens ₹2,500 Crore QIP
articles.extract: AI SaaS startup Dreamteam raised $53 million from Together Fund, Accel and Premji Invest. Urban Company opened a ₹2,500 crore QIP, and Rediff filed updated draft papers with SEBI for a ₹600 crore IPO made up only of new shares.

articles.title: India IPO Daily Market & IPO Updates | 18th November 2026
articles.extract: Rediff.com India filed an updated DRHP with SEBI for a ₹600 crore IPO, entirely through a fresh issue with no offer for sale. Advanced Sys-Tek received SEBI approval for its IPO and Meganet Technologies filed for a ₹740 crore IPO.

articles.title: Humyn Labs Raises $47 Mn To Collect Training Data For Robots
articles.extract: Startup Humyn Labs has raised $47 million in funding to collect training data for robots.

articles.title: Leaders commit to accelerate action on obesity prevention and control
articles.extract: Spain and 20 other countries joined WHO and UNICEF at the Global Obesity Summit to launch a global call to action on obesity, Bending the curve by 2030. More than 1 billion people worldwide are now living with obesity.

articles.title: Press release of Consumer Price Index on base 2024=100 for October, 2026
articles.extract: Retail inflation based on the Consumer Price Index in October 2026 is 6.09%, and food inflation is 8.94%, according to the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation.

articles.title: Retail inflation hits 24-month high of 6.09% in October, crosses RBI's upper tolerance limit ahead of December MPC meet
articles.extract: India's retail inflation rose to 6.09% in October 2026 from 5.54% in September, the highest since October 2024 and above the RBI's upper tolerance limit, ahead of the December MPC meeting.

articles.title: RBI announces premature redemption rate for Sovereign Gold Bonds due November 18
articles.extract: The RBI set the premature redemption price of a Sovereign Gold Bond tranche due on November 18 at ₹13,499 per unit, based on the average gold price of the previous three business days.

articles.title: CAT 2026 admit card @ iimcat.ac.in, IIM Indore to release hall ticket today, November 4
articles.extract: IIM Indore is scheduled to release the CAT 2026 admit card. The exam will take place on November 29, 2026.
